policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. Update measured counts in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances; never lower a floor without an explicit, justified scope change.

tolerance.rationale: The #369 body-observer ownership fix adds one instrumented and covered client/core line so stale handles compare their exact subscriber identity before cleanup, advancing the reviewed high-water from 2326/2666 (87.247%) to 2327/2667 (87.252%). Two clean Node 22.20/V8 runs on 2026-07-27 each passed all 1788 tests across 233 files and reproduced exactly 2327/2667. Retaining the existing one-line tolerance makes the minimum 2326/2667 (87.214%), stricter than the prior 2325/2666 tolerated floor (87.209%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The final #453 injected-shell HTTP boundary pass keeps four fixed admission stripes and bodyless cold/changed HEAD responses, then replaces downstream replay with a 2 MiB one-pass threshold stream, evaluates source preconditions before fallback bytes commit, bypasses host-owned ranges, and keys the cache by ASP.NET Core's finite selected identity/gzip/Brotli representation. The resulting callback, cancellation, date-validator, write-surface, wildcard/duplicate negotiation, and real compression regressions add 129 instrumented lines and cover 113 of them. Six clean .NET 10.0.9/Coverlet runs on 2026-07-27 each passed all 2,306 tests: the first measured the reviewed high-water at 27,434/36,167 instrumented lines (75.854%), and all five immediate repeats reproduced 27,433/36,167 exactly, a one-line instrumentation variation. Retaining the existing evidence-bounded five-line Coverlet tolerance makes the minimum 27,429/36,167 (75.840%), stricter than the prior 27,316/36,038 tolerated floor (75.798%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
